name: T07 Voter: rank, reorder and cast a ballot
description: A voter ranks options with buttons only (no drag and drop), changes their mind, casts the ballot and gets a receipt.

planSteps.description: Click the "Rank" button next to Kraków
Click the "Rank" button next to Lisbon
Click the "Rank" button next to Tallinn
In "Your ranking", click "Move up" on Lisbon
The page shows the heading "Your receipt" and a receipt code made of three groups of four characters separated by dashes, like abcd-efgh-ijkl
